content:
sam: Quick microcopy + a11y nit for the code-input inline helper. Right now it says `Input too long` under the box. Feels abrupt and doesn't suggest fixes.
lucy: +1. Also the helper disappears when focus moves; screen-reader users get no announcement. We need aria-live and a clearer line.
omar: Proposal for helper copy: 
- Short: "Input exceeds the 8,192 token limit. Shorten or split your input."
- With count: "Your input is 9,100 / 8,192 tokens. Remove context or split into multiple requests."
- Friendly: "Looks like this input is too long. Try trimming context or sending in smaller chunks. View limits."
karla: I like the count variant but we should avoid raw numbers for very long strings — show abbreviated like "9.1k / 8.2k tokens" optionally. And make the 'View limits' a text button that opens the quota modal.
design-bot: [automated] Current helper text=`Input too long` severity=error code=INPUT_OVER_LIMIT retention=5s
sam: Accessibility: announce inline helper with aria-live="assertive" when it becomes visible. For toasts use assertive too, but only when API returns an error. Helper should be persistent while the input is over the limit.
lucy: Micro-interaction: if the user pastes content that pushes over the limit, show the inline helper immediately and pre-populate a short diff hint: "You pasted 1.2k tokens over the limit." That requires the tokenizer on client. If not available, show generic: "You pasted more than the limit."
omar: Button microcopy: primary action on helper = "Trim input" which opens a small editor with suggestions to remove system prompts/long context. Secondary = "Split now" to create two requests. Both actions should have SR-friendly labels.
karla: For the toast on server rejects, copy should map to helper and include the counts if the headers exist: "Request rejected: 9,100 / 8,192 tokens. Shorten your input or split it. View limits." Keep toast retention longer (8s) and ensure it focuses a visible element (not the toast) to avoid focus loss.
sam: Action items: 1) UX: I'll update mocks with count variant + abbreviated numbers. 2) Frontend: Lucy please add aria-live and keep helper persistent. 3) API: Omar, can you standardize X-Used-Tokens/X-Token-Limit headers? 4) PM: Karla will sign off on 'Trim input' flow.
karla: OK from PM side as long as we don't auto-delete user text. 'Trim input' should open suggestions but require explicit confirm.
sam: I'll open the PR with copy + a11y strings and include the SR phrasing: "Input exceeds your workspace token limit 8,192 tokens. Shorten or split your input. View limits."
lucy: Thanks all, will add the aria-live tests to the accessibility checklist.
omar: I'll start a backend ticket for the headers and include an example response.
karla: LGTM 9:thumbsup:'
